title: Cool blocks
description: adds some cool custom blocks to minecraft
body:
# Cool Blocks!

this mod adds some cool blocks and adds some custom world gen with those blocks as well!

## What kinda blocks?

It adds the following blocks:

- Metal
- Amber
- Corn
- Amber Ore
- Goofy Metal

and add the item Amber Ingot

### how to craft the blocks

Amber ore can be found underground beetween y 64 and y 0

Amber ingot can obtain by mining Amber Ore

the goofy metal can only be obtain via creative

this is how to craft corn
you need one seed in the middle of crafting table

![the crafting for corn. 1 seed in the middle of crafting table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/604d1aa2aece457c1640fb1d0a2d47d42412f52e.png)

this is how to craft the amber block
you fill the crafting table with amber ingots
> note: amber ingots share the same texture as the gold ingot

![the crafting for amber block. all amber ingots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d7a5ebae4b5a8869843fb41f32193531a129674.png)

and this is how to craft metal
you fill in the crafting table with iron blocks

![how to craft metal. all iron blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b49e7ade19c58165ae906cd63fc171f3ced068e.png)
